steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In April 2026, a guest on Equity Mates described Booking as an online travel agent across Booking.com and Agoda with over one billion room nights booked last year, adding flights, cars and experiences, while most economics were driven by hotel bookings due to fragmented supply and perishable inventory.

episode.title: Finding opportunities in well-known names with Ryan Joyce

views.text: In February 2024, Equity Mates said Booking spanned brands like Booking.com, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable, and cited scale metrics including 896 million room nights, 62 million car rentals, 23 million plane tickets and a 41% share of OTA gross bookings, highlighting a broad, popular travel service.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In April 2026, a guest on Equity Mates explained Booking aimed to convert users from Google to its app where it made far more than “almost no money” via Google, and argued it was well placed for AI with relationships, loyalty, data, reviews and technical capability to support ongoing profitability.

episode.title: Finding opportunities in well-known names with Ryan Joyce

views.text: In February 2024, Equity Mates noted Booking’s industry position with 41% of online travel agency gross bookings and 555 million monthly website hits, implying scale advantages that could support above-market profitability.
